verbs.name: score.clip
verbs.description: Score a clip or asset time-range 0..100 for 'keep-worthiness' from the perception report -- so an agent (or an assemble.repurpose-style flow) can RANK footage without a model. NON-MUTATING: reads the perception facts, computes a score, edits nothing. Pass `clip` (its SOURCE range is scored) OR `asset` (with optional `range_ms`; default is the whole asset by its probed duration). The score blends speech density (1 - silence fraction), word rate, ASR confidence, loudness energy, and -- for multi-shot footage only -- visual dynamics (scene-cut rate), renormalized over whichever signals are present (so a single continuous take is NOT penalized for lacking cuts), then scaled down by the fraction of the range that is dead footage (black/frozen). Returns the score with its full per-factor value + weight + raw-signal breakdown so the verdict is auditable and re-weightable. Requires media.perception to have run on the asset (errors actionably otherwise).

clip.description: Timeline clip id; its source range [src_in_ms, src_out_ms] is scored.

asset.description: Asset id to score (alternative to clip).

range_ms.description: [lo, hi] source ms to score (asset mode; default = whole asset).

verbs.result: {asset, range_ms:[lo,hi], duration_ms, score (0..100), factors:{speech_density?,word_rate?,confidence?,energy?,visual_dynamics?}, weights:{...}, signals:{words, silence_ms, scenes, mean_momentary_lufs, dead_ms}}
